scoring_justification: Checker recomputes G0, K from public elastic constants and compares to paper-reported values; also structurally verifies G0 equals Hill average.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected G0 and K values from paper Table 1

outputs.description: CSV file with computed shear modulus G0 and bulk modulus K for six cubic crystals. The hidden checker recomputes G0 and K from the provided single-crystal elastic constants, compares the agent's values to paper-reported values, and performs structural consistency checks against Voigt, Reuss, and Hill averages.

output_contract.notes: The single-crystal elastic constants are provided inline in the instruction. The agent must compute the required properties directly from those constants. No external dataset download is required. The task is purely arithmetic and requires only standard Python libraries.

steps.description: Verify G0 matches Hill average (Voigt-Reuss half-sum) within tolerance.
